received_proposals.exact_message: Firms A and B commit to the profitable 16-unit quota. I endorse this agreement and commit to producing 16 units in Round 8 to maximize our joint profits.
Firms A and B, I propose an unequal split: A=8, B=8, C=32 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This redistributes existing profits without improving the total. Please accept this allocation.
